price_out_of_band_scaling.decision: Repaired 37,351 unit prices: 36,352 zero or missing prices and 999 prices outside 0.5x to 2.0x the SKU-year reference (581 near 100x, 33 near 85x, 385 in the 5x to 20x band).
price_out_of_band_scaling.reason: Corrects cent-scale entry errors, currency conversion disparities, and manual data-entry slips while maintaining intra-year price stability.

blank_region_categorization.decision: Assigned persistent unmatchable blank regions to canonical category 'Unassigned'.
blank_region_categorization.reason: Preserves total company sales volume and transaction count without guessing geographic origins.

high_volume_orders.decision: Replaced suspected entry errors above 20 times the SKU-year median.
high_volume_orders.reason: Uses the SKU-year median and records each replacement in the audit log.

sku_bu_conflict_resolution.decision: Assigned PMP-004 to Business Unit 'Advanced Manufacturing' per Rule R8 and transaction history majority.

customer_series_deduplication.decision: Deduplicated series strictly on Date, SKU_ID, Region, Customer_Name by retaining latest Load_Timestamp.
customer_series_deduplication.reason: Resolves multiple records loaded across differing sales channels for the same customer account; establishes authoritative 244,321 cleaned transaction rows.

stockout_account_allocation.decision: Allocated inventory stockouts defined at Date-SKU-Region proportionally across active customer accounts by non-negative volume, with remainder to largest customer.
stockout_account_allocation.reason: Preserves individual customer demand history while ensuring exact conservation of reported stockout units.
